name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Either 10 ly goes with Callisto or Cho goes with Ganymede.
Dasari goes with Europa if and only if Anders does not go with Titan.
If either Anders does not go with Titan or Dasari does not go with 10 ly, then both 10 ly does not go with Ganymede and 4 ly goes with Anders.
Either Titan goes with Dasari or 8 ly goes with Callisto.

hints.text: Suppose Anders went with Europa — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Anders goes with Europa.
Anders goes with Europa, so it can't also go with Titan.
Europa goes with Anders, so Dasari can't go with Europa.
…but now the clue “Dasari goes with Europa if and only if Anders does not go with Titan” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Anders does not go with Europa.
